text:
ria: quick heads-up from UX QA on the batch embeddings -> export flow. two accessibility & clarity issues: 1) the export summary shows raw vectors in a scroll region that SR reads verbatim when the modal opens, 2) the confirm button reads only 'Export' which is ambiguous when exporting multiple sets.

ben: can repro. SR focus seems to land on the first focusable item inside the preview which causes the giant blob to be announced. also keyboard users end up tabbing through hundreds of cells if they expand the preview.

anita: recommended a11y fixes:
- trap focus in the modal but set initial focus to the modal heading (tabindex=-1 + focus())
- keep the preview DOM aria-hidden until user toggles 'Expand preview'
- provide an aria-live region with a short summary: e.g. 'Preview collapsed: 24 rows, ~200KB.'
- button aria-label: 'Start export of 24 vectors' for the primary action

marc: on copy and UX:
- modal heading: 'Export 24 vectors from Batch A'
- primary CTA: 'Start export' with visually hidden subtext 'Runs in background'
- preview toggle label: 'Expand export preview (24 rows, ~200KB)'
- file name: default to 'batch-a-2026-03-23-vectors.csv' to avoid ambiguity

zoe: product constraints:
- exports can take a while; add a checkbox 'Email me when ready' (checked) and a retention note 'Download link expires in 7 days'.
- add analytics: export_started(export_id, count, format, notify_opt_in)

deploy-bot: staging: export-modal-a11y-fix pushed to staging (commit bf12e7)

ria: action items recap: focus heading on open (dev), hide preview from AT until expanded (dev), add aria-live summary (dev+a11y), change CTA copy + aria-label (design), default filename pattern (product/eng), add notify checkbox + retention text (product), add telemetry (eng). I'll create Figma update and tickets.

ben: +1, I'll take focus + aria-hidden work.

anita: +1, adding checklist to ticket.

marc: +1, will post copy variants in the frame.

zoe: +1, filed product ticket with retention requirements.
